extension.summary: Resonance: a minimal Spotify music browser and player for Kodi
Spotify-Premium-Musik in Kodi hören: Resonance-Plugin (Spotty/librespot), für ARM/LibreELEC auf Raspberry Pi
extension.description: Resonance is a lightweight Spotify music browser for Kodi focused on playlists, search, albums, artists and playback. Version 1 is built and tested for LibreELEC on Raspberry Pi ARM/AArch64, with experimental Android ARM binaries included. Windows, macOS and Linux x86/x64 are not supported in this release. Spotify Premium is required.

Resonance ist ein leichtgewichtiges Spotify-Musik-Add-on für Kodi mit Playlists, Suche, Alben, Künstlern und Wiedergabe. Version 1 ist für LibreELEC auf Raspberry Pi ARM/AArch64 gebaut und getestet; Android-ARM-Binärdateien sind experimentell enthalten. Spotify Premium ist erforderlich.
extension.disclaimer: This product uses the SPOTIFY WEB API but is not endorsed, certified or otherwise approved in any way by Spotify. Spotify is the registered trademark of Spotify AB.
Dieses Produkt verwendet die SPOTIFY WEB API, wird jedoch in keiner Weise von Spotify unterstützt, zertifiziert oder anderweitig genehmigt. Spotify ist eine eingetragene Marke von Spotify AB.
extension.news:
[B]1.0.2[/B] - Added artist context menus from track, album and artist rows. - Added artist top songs, albums, singles, appears-on and combined artist overview pages. - Artist top songs falls back to search when Spotify blocks the top-tracks endpoint.
[B]1.0.1[/B] - Hotfix: preserve the Spotify browser-login refresh token when Spotify refresh responses omit a replacement token, so catalogue sign-in survives access-token expiry and addon restarts. - Added the option to hide playlists Resonance cannot read and refresh the current menu when changed.
[B]1.0.0[/B] - Version 1 release of Resonance for Kodi. - Spotify Web API-only catalogue: search, playlists, albums, artists, links and track metadata use the browser PKCE token. - Single setup flow: Spotify Connect pairing for playback first, then browser PKCE sign-in for the catalogue. - Hosted callback relay for the browser sign-in (https://resonance-spotify-callback.vercel.app/api/callback) with paste-code fallback; configurable Client ID and redirect URI in Settings. - Persistent catalogue cache, loopback audio streaming service and shared provider rate-limit/cooldown handling. - Supported target: LibreELEC on Raspberry Pi ARM/AArch64. Android ARM is experimental. Windows, macOS and Linux x86/x64 are not supported in this release.
